title: Fix auto-chain-signal bug via convention — add <chain_advancement> (signal-complete instruction) to json_output content_template (one DB row + seed_bridge.py, fixes all trade roles)
design_notes:
Fixes the auto-chain-signal bug found in kørsel 51 (trade_cockpit_simulation_v001): none of the 7 trade roles ran dispatch.py --signal-complete after writing their output, so the auto-chain stalled at every step (6 manual signal-complete interventions needed). Root cause found via mcp-light get_role + direct DB query: the `json_output` content_template (bridge_convention_rules.rule_key='json_output') — injected into every trade role's prompt — tells the role to WRITE the output JSON ('Write YOUR output to {deliverable_dir}/{output_file}') and says 'Your JSON output will be imported and used by the next role', but NEVER instructs the role to run signal-complete. So roles write the file and stop, expecting auto-advance that never comes.

FIX (convention approach, ONE change vs 7 governance file edits): add a <chain_advancement> block to the json_output content_template with the exact signal-complete command. Because the convention is injected into every json_output role automatically, this fixes all 7 trade roles (and reinforces signal-complete for any other json_output flow) in a single DB row update.

THE <chain_advancement> BLOCK to add (before </json_output>, after <notification>):
<chain_advancement>
After writing your output JSON to the path above, you MUST signal completion so the bridge dispatches the next role. Run:
    timeout 30 python3 /home/svend/DPMtF-WebUI/scripts/bridgeV002/dispatch.py \
      --db-flow {flow_key} --signal-complete --from-role {next_role} --id {flow_run_id}
{flow_key}, {next_role}, {flow_run_id} are already resolved for you. The `timeout 30` is required (dispatch.py's post-dispatch step hangs; the signal lands before the timeout). Do NOT skip — without signal-complete the next role is never dispatched and the chain stalls. (Final role: signal-complete marks the run complete.)
</chain_advancement>

NOTE on the timeout: dispatch.py has a separate post-dispatch-hang bug (the ollama-stop step hangs) — this convention fix uses `timeout 30` as a workaround so the role's turn ends cleanly after the signal lands. The dispatch.py hang itself is a separate bug to fix later (bridge-fix, not governance).

SCOPE:
1. UPDATE bridge_convention_rules.content_template for rule_key='json_output' — add the <chain_advancement> block. Keep the existing <task>/<constraint>/<notification> blocks intact.
2. UPDATE scripts/seed_bridge.py to match (so fresh DBs get the fix — reproducibility per StartUpNextSession §8.1).
3. VALIDATE: query the convention content (confirm chain_advancement block present + placeholders correct); build/inspect a sample dispatch prompt to confirm the block appears in the injected prompt; optionally run python3 scripts/bridgeV002/dispatch.py --dry-run or inspect dispatch.py's prompt-construction.
4. A full live re-test (kørsel 52 of trade_cockpit_simulation_v001) is the recommended FINAL validation — but that's a separate Human-triggered step (tokens + external API). The handoff validates the convention/prompt-construction; the Human triggers kørsel 52 to confirm roles now self-signal.

The json_output convention is also used by non-trade flows (cloud_pay, strict_review roles that use json_output). Adding signal-complete reinforces it for them too — cloud_pay implementer already signaled complete in handoffs 59-63 (so redundant-but-harmless there). If a flow's role should NOT signal-complete (e.g. humanpay), the convention injection would need a conditional — but no such case known (humanpay is role_type=human, dispatch skips injection).
